author: nickyeow

english.text: It is important for him to get the job.

jyutping: go2 fan2 gung1 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 hou2 zung6 jiu3。
text: 嗰份工對佢嚟講好重要。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She was kind enough to lend me a large sum of money.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 hou2 jan4，ze3 zo2 jat1 daai6 bat1 cin4 bei2 ngo5。
text: 佢好好人，借咗一大筆錢俾我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 baai2 ming4 zau6 hai6 dou3 gei6 keoi5 jau6 jau5 cin2 jau6 jau5 dei6 wai6 laa1。
text: 佢哋擺明就係妒忌佢又有錢又有地位啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The man you saw in my office yesterday is from Belgium.

jyutping: nei5 cam4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 baan6 gung1 sat1 dou6 gin3 dou2 go2 go3 jan4 hai6 bei2 lei6 si4 jan4 lai4 ge3。
text: 你尋日喺我辦工室度見到嗰個人係比利時人嚟嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The girl began to cry at the sight of a dog.

jyutping: go3 neoi5 zai2 jat1 gin3 dou2 zek3 gau2 zau6 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4。
text: 個女仔一見到隻狗就喊咗出嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She got married in her teens.

jyutping: keoi5 sap6 gei2 seoi3 zau6 git3 zo2 fan1。
text: 佢十幾歲就結咗婚。

author: aruhito

english.text: Do you like San Francisco?

jyutping: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 saam1 faan4 si5 aa3？
text: 你鍾唔鍾意三藩市呀？

author: fercheung

english.text: He wanted to succeed.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 sing4 gung1。
text: 佢好想成功。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let's go by taxi, OK?

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fei1 dik1 heoi3 laa1，hou2 mou2？
text: 我哋飛的去啦，好冇？

author: kaenif

english.text: We were very busy last week.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng5 go3 lai5 baai3 hou2 mong4。
text: 我哋上個禮拜好忙。

author: kaenif

english.text: The family lived in poverty.

jyutping: go2 gaa1 jan4 wut6 hai2 pan4 kung4 zi1 zung1。
text: 嗰家人活喺貧窮之中。

author: kaenif

english.text: He was acclaimed as the best writer of the year.

jyutping: keoi5 cing1 wai4 nin4 dou6 zeoi3 gaai1 zok3 gaa1。
text: 佢稱為年度最佳作家。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who's your favorite philosopher?

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 go3 zit3 hok6 gaa1？
text: 你最鍾意邊個哲學家？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom hung the ornaments on the Christmas tree.

jyutping: aa3 Tom zoeng1 di1 zong1 sik1 gwaa3 zo2 soeng6 fo2 sing3 daan3 syu6 dou3。
text: 阿Tom將啲裝飾掛咗上棵聖誕樹到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They let me go.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bei2 ngo5 zau2。
text: 佢哋俾我走。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This year, Valentine's Day falls on a Thursday.

jyutping: gam1 nin4 cing4 jan4 zit3 hai6 sing1 kei4 sei3。
text: 今年情人節係星期四。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You don't have to hide anything from me.

jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 deoi3 ngo5 jan2 mun4 di1 me1 gaa3。
text: 你唔使對我隱瞞啲咩㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You were asleep by the time I got home.

jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6 nei5 ji5 ging1 fan3 zoek6 zo2 laa3。
text: 我返到屋企嗰陣你已經瞓著咗喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The past can only be known, not changed. The future can only be changed, not known.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 wui4 gu3 gwo3 heoi3，daan6 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 gwo3 heoi3；ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 mei6 loi4，daan6 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 jyu6 zi1 mei6 loi4。
text: 我哋可以回顧過去，但係唔可以改變過去；我哋可以改變未來，但係唔可以預知未來。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Right around the corner!

jyutping: hou2 gan6 gaa3 zaa3！
text: 好近㗎咋！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did someone break your heart?

jyutping: jau5 jan4 gaau2 dou3 nei5 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3？
text: 有人搞到你唔開心呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: What a waste!

jyutping: saai1 saai3！
text: 嘥晒！

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: Why are you wasting your time with Tom?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei5 zoeng1 si4 gaan3 long6 fai3 hai2 Tom san1 soeng6？
text: 点解你将时间浪费喺Tom身上？

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Use your words," his mother told him when he tried to strike his brother.

jyutping: keoi5 soeng2 daa2 keoi5 sai3 lou2，keoi5 aa3 maa1 zau6 tung4 keoi5 gong2：「gwan1 zi2 dung6 hau2 bat1 dung6 sau2。」
text: 佢想打佢細佬，佢阿媽就同佢講：「君子動口不動手。」

author: bearyung

english.text: How come that idiot is here?

jyutping: zou6 mat1 go3 baak6 ci1 zai2 wui5 hei2 dou6 gaa3?
text: 做乜個白癡仔會起度架?

author: thesilhouette

english.text: She was hit by a car.
He was hit by a car.

jyutping: keoi5 bei2 ce1 zong6。
text: 渠畀車撞。

author: FishlandicFishy

english.text: Words, words...

jyutping: zi6、zi6⋯⋯
text: 字、字⋯⋯

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom was crying when I got home.

jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6 aa3 tong1 hai2 dou6 haam3。
text: 我返到屋企嗰陣阿湯喺度喊。

english.text: In New York State, falsification of business records itself, the second degree, is a misdemeanor. However, if it was used with the intention or really to commit another crime, it would be a first-degree falsification of business records, which would be classified as a felony.

jyutping: hai2 nau2 joek3 zau1，ngai6 zou6 soeng1 jip6 gei2 luk6 bun2 san1，zik1 hai6 ji6 kap1，suk6 jyu1 heng1 zeoi6。bat1 gwo3，jyu4 gwo2 hai6 jung6 lei4 daa2 syun3 waak6 ze2 zan1 hai6 faan6 kei4 taa1 zeoi6，zau6 wui6 hai6 jat1 kap1 ngai6 zou6 soeng1 jip6 gei2 luk6，zau6 suk6 jyu1 cung5 zeoi6。
text: 喺紐約州，偽造商業紀錄本身，即係二級，屬於輕罪。不過，如果係用嚟打算或者真係犯其他罪，就會係一級偽造商業紀錄，就屬於重罪。

english.text: A story from another planet: On a distant planet, there are two moons in the night sky, Flimsy and Hefty. A child asks his father, "Dear Dad, why are there two moons in the sky?" The father says, "Oh, what sort of question is that? How many eyes do you have? There are two. How many hands do you have? There are two." The child replies, "But, Dad, I only have one nose...."

jyutping: ling6 jat1 go3 sing1 kau4 ge3 gu3 si6：hai2 jat1 go3 jiu4 jyun5 ge3 sing1 kau4 soeng6，je6 hung1 jau5 loeng5 go3 jyut6 loeng6， Flimsy tung4 Hefty 。jau5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 man6 keoi5 baa4 baa1：「can1 oi3 ge3 baa4 baa1，dim2 gaai2 tin1 hung1 jau5 loeng5 go3 jyut6 loeng6？」 ，ni1 go3 hai6 me1 man6 tai4？nei5 jau5 gei2 zek3 ngaan5？nei5 jau5 gei2 zek3 sau2？jau5 loeng5 zek3。」go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 daap3：「daan6 hai6，baa4 baa1，ngo5 dak1 faan2 jat1 zek3 bei6。」
text: 另一個星球嘅故事：喺一個遙遠嘅星球上，夜空有兩個月亮， Flimsy 同 Hefty 。有個小朋友問佢爸爸：「親愛嘅爸爸，點解天空有兩個月亮？」 ，呢個係咩問題？你有幾隻眼？你有幾隻手？有兩隻。」個小朋友答：「但係，爸爸，我得返一隻鼻。」
